mapper.select: WITH pm AS ( SELECT user_id FROM members WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND mobile = #{mobileEnc} LIMIT 1 ), root AS ( SELECT p.id AS promoter_id, p.pid AS parent_pid FROM popularize_promoter p INNER JOIN pm ON p.user_id = pm.user_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId} WHERE p.is_promoter = 1 LIMIT 1 ), non_top_children AS ( SELECT c.user_id AS user_id FROM popularize_promoter c CROSS JOIN root r WHERE r.parent_pid > 0 AND c.company_id = #{companyId} AND c.pid = r.promoter_id AND c.is_promoter = 0 AND c.disabled = 0 ), top_l1 AS ( SELECT c.user_id AS user_id, c.is_promoter AS is_promoter, c.id AS id FROM popularize_promoter c CROSS JOIN root r WHERE r.parent_pid = 0 AND c.company_id = #{companyId} AND c.pid = r.promoter_id AND c.disabled = 0 ), top_l2 AS ( SELECT c2.user_id AS user_id FROM popularize_promoter c2 INNER JOIN top_l1 l1 ON l1.is_promoter = 1 AND c2.company_id = #{companyId} AND c2.pid = l1.id AND c2.is_promoter = 0 AND c2.disabled = 0 ) SELECT user_id FROM non_top_children UNION SELECT user_id FROM top_l1 UNION SELECT user_id FROM top_l2
